$comment: EZVIZ smart plugs (T30 and alike): no local API, so CLOUD ONLY (pattern P5) -- works only while the hub has internet. Format: wiki Device-Templates.
name: EZVIZ smart plug
description: EZVIZ T30 and other EZVIZ plugs, through the EZVIZ account. Needs internet: EZVIZ plugs can't be reached on the local network.

inputs.label: EZVIZ account email (or phone)
inputs.hint: What you log in to the EZVIZ app with

inputs.label: EZVIZ password
inputs.hint: Used once to log in; the hub doesn't keep it

inputs.label: Verification code
inputs.hint: EZVIZ sent it by SMS or email (two-step verification is on)

setup.label: Log in to the EZVIZ account

steps.hint: EZVIZ plugs only work through EZVIZ's cloud: this plug will need internet. The hub keeps a login session, never your password.
